name: titanforged
lore_descriptor: bronze-gold, struck in patterns no human smith could match
first_pickup_chronicle: Titanforged. The pre-Olympian smiths. Heavier than anything mortal craftsmen attempt — only those who already passed the Trial of Strength can lift it without a chain.
design_notes: Band E heavy magical_metal. Mult 1.65, weight 1.7, enchant 2. Late-game brute archetype — sister to tungsten/pig_iron in spirit. Unbreakable (cannot be sundered) + extra dmg vs giants for the lore payoff. Fills Band E heavy gap.
